verdicts.decision_note: The client establishes the required USBLC6-2SC6 supply connection and D+/D- routing needed for functional USB data-line protection.
First concrete failure: all tested boards fail USB enumeration, with the grounded U3 VBUS pin identified as clamping the protected data lines.
The client adds concrete schematic requirements separating U3 pins 2 and 5 while retaining D+/D- pass-through and ESD protection; no prior attributes become obsolete.
Target-specific implementation claim: the bounded exchange resolves "Fixed" to the requested U3 wiring correction, without asserting runtime verification.
